map.灯具角度与位置计算 使用指南: Fixture Angle and Position Calculation User Guide
map.输入灯具投射距离与安装高度，计算投光角度与水平偏移量，用于舞台、场馆布灯定位与光: Enter the fixture projection distance and mounting height to compute the projection angle and horizontal offset, for design calculations of stage and venue lighting position and spot coverage.
map.面光（正面光）通常取 40–50° 投射角，根据舞台台口高度与灯具吊点距离反推安: Front light (frontal light) usually takes a 40-50° projection angle, and the mounting angle is back-calculated from the stage opening height and the fixture hanging distance.
map.侧光/耳光取 30–60°，用高度与水平距离算俯角与斜射距离，避免演员面部阴影过: Side light or ear light is taken at 30-60°; use the height and horizontal distance to compute the depression angle and slant distance, avoiding heavy shadows on the performer's face.
map.已知投射角与高度，反算水平安装距离，并叠加光束角得到光斑覆盖直径与面积。: Given the projection angle and height, back out the horizontal mounting distance, and add the beam angle to get spot coverage diameter and area.
map.算例：高 6m、距 5m 的面光: Worked example: front light at 6 m height and 5 m distance
: fixture height 6 m, horizontal distance 5 m: projection angle = arctan(6/5) ≈ 50.2°, depression angle ≈ 39.8°, slant distance ≈ 7.81 m, height/distance ratio 1.20, front light (frontal light, 40-50°). Taking a 45° projection angle at 6 m height with a 25° beam angle: horizontal mounting distance = 6 / tan45° = 6.00 m, slant distance ≈ 8.49 m, spot radius ≈ 1.88 m, diameter ≈ 3.76 m, illuminated area ≈ 11.12 m².

map.投射角越大越好吗？: Is a larger projection angle always better?
map.不是。角度过大趋近顶光/逆光，会减少面部亮度、加重阴影；面光以 40–50° 为: No. Too large an angle approaches top light or back light, reducing facial brightness and deepening shadows; front light works best at 40-50° and side light at 45-60°, combined by styling goal.
map.高度和距离哪个对光斑大小影响更大？: Which affects spot size more, height or distance?
map.在固定光束角下，光斑直径 ≈ 2 × 斜射距离 × tan(半角)，斜射距离随高: At a fixed beam angle, spot diameter ≈ 2 × slant distance × tan(half angle), and slant distance grows with both height and distance, so the two together determine coverage area.
